name: Gear Potentiometer in Bounds
hint: The gear potentiometer reports values from 0 to 100, providing usable position information for the robot.
instruction: Use thresholds within 0–100 for comparisons and control decisions based on the potentiometer.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB gear potentiometer value :: sensing) > (50)> then
say [Gear position set]
end
